Description: "Refactored handleCheckout to calculate and apply pre-order advance payments. If posSettings.countAdvanceInSales is enabled, the advance is subtracted from the total_price (sale amount) saved to database. Otherwise, the full grandTotal is recorded. Included pre_order_id, pre_order_advance, and pre_order_balance columns in the order payload."
Instruction: "Update newOrder calculations and fields in handleCheckout in App.jsx."
TargetContent:
"    const orderId = editingOrder ? editingOrder.id : `L-${Date.now()}`;
    const { subtotal, discountAmt, cgst, sgst, serviceCharge, extraFixed, total } = calculateTotals(activeCart);
    const grandTotal = total + (parseFloat(tip) || 0);
    const newOrder = { 
      id: orderId, 
      customer_name: customerName || "POS Guest", 
      customer_phone: customerPhone, 
      customer_number: customerPhone, 
      address: customerAddress || "",
      items: activeCart.map(i => ({ 
        id: i.id,
        name: i.product_name, 
        qty: i.quantity, 
        price: i.price,
        modifiers: i.modifiers || [],
        kot_category: i.kot_category || "Main Kitchen"
      })), 
      subtotal,
      discount: discountAmt,
      tax_cgst: cgst,
      tax_sgst: sgst,
      delivery_charge: extraFixed,
      service_charge: serviceCharge,
      total_price: grandTotal, 
      payment_method: isDue ? 'DUE' : method, 
      reference_no: referenceNo,
      tip_amount: parseFloat(tip) || 0,
      status: type === 'SAVE' ? 'PENDING' : 'COMPLETED', 
      table_id: orderType === 'DINE_IN' ? selectedTable?.id : null, 
      order_type: orderType === 'PICKUP' ? subOrderType : orderType,
      created_at: editingOrder ? (editingOrder.created_at || new Date().toISOString()) : new Date().toISOString(),
      bill_no: bNo,
      synced: false
    };"
